req.title: Update unknown returns 404
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 when PUT targets a non-existent task id.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-011 requires that PUT /tasks/{task_id} returns HTTP 404 when the task_id does not exist. The violation was in test[4]: kind='negative' but heuristic='BVA'. A negative test must use heuristic 'NEG' (or 'EP' for equivalence partitioning of invalid inputs). Since id=0 is below the minimum valid id and the test is asserting an error pathway (404), the correct heuristic is 'NEG'. The fix changes test[4] heuristic from 'BVA' to 'NEG'. All other tests are preserved exactly as before.

tests.name: test_put_existing_task_returns_200
preconditions: Database contains pre-loaded rows with ids 1-20
Task id=1 exists with title 'Read chapter 5'
actions: Send PUT /tasks/1 with a valid TaskUpdate payload (title='Updated title')
Inspect response status code and JSON body
expected: Response JSON contains id=1 and title='Updated title'
Response JSON contains field 'completed' equal to true (unchanged)
trace: R-TASK-011: positive path — existing task must NOT return 404
Kills mutation: always-return-404 in update_task handler
Kills mutation: None-check negation in crud.update_task
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)
payload = {"title": "Updated title"}
r = client.put("/tasks/1", json=payload)
assert r.status_code == 200
body = r.json()
assert body["id"] == 1
assert body["title"] == "Updated title"
assert body["completed"] is True

tests.name: test_put_nonexistent_task_returns_404
preconditions: Database contains pre-loaded rows with ids 1-20 only
actions: Send PUT /tasks/99999 with a valid TaskUpdate payload
Inspect response status code and JSON detail field
expected: Response JSON detail contains 'Task with id 99999 not found'
trace: R-TASK-011: primary error pathway — non-existent id must yield 404
Kills mutation: detail string constant mutation
Kills mutation: None-check inversion (if db_task is not None)

tests.name: test_put_boundary_id_21_before_and_after_creation
preconditions: Database contains exactly 20 pre-loaded rows with ids 1-20
Task id=21 does not exist before the test
actions: Send PUT /tasks/21 before creating it — expect 404
Create a new task via POST /tasks/ — it receives id=21
expected: First PUT returns HTTP 404 with detail 'Task with id 21 not found'
Second PUT returns HTTP 200 with updated fields
trace: R-TASK-011: boundary at id=21 (first id beyond pre-loaded set)
Kills off-by-one mutation on id boundary (20 vs 21)
Kills mutation: status code 404 -> 200 on missing task
STC: state transition from non-existent to existent task
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)
r_before = client.put("/tasks/21", json={"title": "Boundary test"})
assert r_before.status_code == 404
body_before = r_before.json()
assert body_before["detail"] == "Task with id 21 not found"
r_create = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "New boundary task", "completed": False})
assert r_create.status_code == 201
created = r_create.json()
assert created["id"] == 21
r_after = client.put("/tasks/21", json={"title": "Updated boundary task"})
assert r_after.status_code == 200
body_after = r_after.json()
assert body_after["id"] == 21
assert body_after["title"] == "Updated boundary task"

tests.name: test_put_id_20_last_preloaded_returns_200
preconditions: Database contains pre-loaded rows with ids 1-20
Task id=20 exists with title 'Reply to emails'
actions: Inspect response status code and body
trace: R-TASK-011: upper boundary of pre-loaded ids — id=20 must NOT return 404
Kills off-by-one mutation where boundary check excludes id=20
Kills mutation: always-return-404 regardless of db lookup result

from app.main import app

tests.name: test_put_id_0_returns_404
preconditions: Database contains pre-loaded rows with ids 1-20
Task id=0 does not exist (ids start at 1)
actions: Send PUT /tasks/0 with a valid payload
Inspect response status code and detail
expected: Response JSON detail equals 'Task with id 0 not found'
trace: R-TASK-011: lower boundary — id=0 is below minimum valid id
Kills off-by-one mutation where id=0 is treated as valid
NEG: invalid partition — id=0 is outside the valid id space (ids start at 1)
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)
r = client.put("/tasks/0", json={"title": "Zero id task"})
assert r.status_code == 404
body = r.json()
assert "detail" in body
assert body["detail"] == "Task with id 0 not found"
